subject: 🎯 Stock Finder: Tue Sep 29 shortlist | thin day — 1 candidate (ILMN), 21 dropped on IBKR checks
html_body:
Stock Finder — Momentum Discovery

Tuesday, September 29, 2026 — Kuwait time

Candidates Cleared

1 of 22 raw tickers scanned

Sources

25 web + IBKR

Thin day — plainly. 21 of 22 raw candidates failed IBKR confirmation: most were already well off their highs, several had flat-out reversed in the last 2-3 sessions despite bullish web-search headlines, one was a live U.S. Army defense-contract catalyst (hard exclusion), and one was defense-certification-driven. Only Illumina (ILMN) held up against live data. No small/mid-cap name survived today — every small/mid candidate found was either faded, stale, or unconfirmable; the single result below is large-cap by necessity, not by search bias.

💵 Live account context (IBKR, pulled just now)

Net liq $533.80 · Cash $432.16 · Only open position: GOOG 0.3 sh @ avg $368.16, mkt $338.31, unrealized -$8.96. SPXC is no longer in the account — consistent with today's daily-portfolio-check run and its overdue defense-rule exit having filled. portfolio.json is still stale as of this run (shows SPXC open, $330.60 cash, last updated Aug 25) — that reconciliation is portfolio-manager's job, not this scan's, flagging only because it's the basis for the sizing below.

🎯 Momentum Shortlist

1 candidate cleared all 4 gates. Run analyze ILMN for the full deep dive before sizing.

#1 — ILMN Illumina Inc. ⭐⭐⭐ (3/5)

HEALTHCARE / LIFE SCIENCE TOOLS LARGE CAP

Signal: Three catalysts stacked in the same week — (1) added to the S&P 500 effective Sept 21 (moved up from S&P MidCap 400, forcing passive-fund buying), (2) Q2 beat: EPS $1.31 vs $1.23 est., revenue $1.16B vs $1.13B est., (3) UBS upgraded Neutral→Buy, PT $135→$260. Stock broke to a new 52-week high of $277.95 intraday on Sept 24 (3 trading days ago), closed that day at $273.90, and has held a tight $262.89-$273.90 consolidation since — still near highs, not chasing.

Price: $271.91 (IBKR, last close)  |  Avg daily $ vol: $698M (IBKR, deep liquidity, fractional-share safe)  |  vs 52w high: 2.2% below ($277.95, set Sept 24)

Why it's interesting: This is the "catalyst already resolved" pattern the strategy favors — earnings risk is behind it, and S&P inclusion creates several more weeks of mechanical passive-fund buying pressure as index funds build positions. The pullback from the Sept 24 high to today's consolidation is orderly (holding above Monday's $262.89 low), not a reversal.

Realistic near-term target: +2% to +7% over 3-7 trading days — TP1 is simply a new-high retest/confirmation, TP2 is a momentum extension on continued index-flow buying.

Entry read: BUY AT MARKET / limit near $272.50 — price is mid-consolidation 3 days post-breakout, not extended relative to its own recent range.

Order plan (GTC, all three legs together):
BUY limit $272.50
Stop-limit trigger $262.50 / limit $261.50 (just below Monday Sep 28's intraday low of $262.89 — the tightest defended support in the current consolidation)
TP1 sell limit $278.00 (just above the Sept 24 all-time/52-week high of $277.95)
TP2 $290.00 (momentum extension)
Size: ~0.294 shares ≈ $80 (15% of live net liq $533.80)
R:R to TP2: risk 3.8% / reward 6.4% ≈ 1.7:1

Sizing note: at ~$80, ~$2 round-trip commission is ~2.5% of the position — TP1 alone (+2.2%) barely clears that; the trade only really pays off if it runs to TP2 (+6.4%) or you hold the position through both legs rather than trimming at TP1.

Event window: Catalyst behind it ✅
Halal: ✅ Verified — genomics/DNA-sequencing instrumentation, core business permissible
Defense/military check: ✅ Clear

Next step: analyze ILMN

🏆 Today's Best Setup

ILMN — by default the only name that survived, but a genuinely clean one: three independent catalysts (S&P inclusion, earnings beat, analyst upgrade) all landed the same week, and the post-spike consolidation is orderly rather than a fade. Invalidation: a close below $262.89 (Monday's low) — that would mean the post-breakout base has failed, not just a normal pullback.

🗑️ Cut This Run — 21 names, showing the work

Hard exclusion — defense/military catalyst

NVTS (Navitas Semiconductor) — the "surge" is the ALATTIS program, a literal U.S. Army contract to develop 10kV SiC power semiconductors for military systems. Catalyst-is-a-DoD-contract-award rule, no exceptions.
VIAV (Viavi Solutions) — rally is headlined by a CMMC Level 2 defense-cybersecurity certification tied to its aerospace/defense product line ("Viavi Wins Key Defense Cybersecurity Nod"). Defense-catalyst adjacent enough to exclude.

Faded / contradicted by live IBKR data

OKLO — search called it "riding an AI power rally"; IBKR shows it at $36.90, 81% below its 52-week high of $193.84 and sitting at its 52-week low. Complete disconnect from the narrative.
META — search said "surged 12% this week"; IBKR daily bars show it peaked at $777.59 close Sept 24, then fell 3 straight sessions to $715.62 (Sept 28) — down 8% from the high, momentum has reversed.
CRWV (CoreWeave) — JPM upgrade PT $125, but price is $84.31, 45% below its 52w high of $153.20, declining on the day.
DG (Dollar General) — HSBC upgrade PT $160, but price is $124.38, 21% off its 52w high, flat/no live momentum — a value call, not a breakout.
PWR (Quanta Services) — Bernstein upgrade PT $775, but price is $643.90, 18% below its 52w high and 11% below its 13-week high.
AUGO (Aura Minerals) — down 16% in a week ($92.77→$77.72, Sept 22-28), the "60% YTD momentum grade" cited by search is stale vs. the live trend.
SSRM (SSR Mining) — down 5 straight sessions, $38.30→$33.84 (-12%), Sept 22-28.
SHIP (Seanergy) — steady 2-week decline, $18.81→$16.42 (-13%), no fresh momentum.
T1 Energy (TE) — gapped up on Giga Arctic data-center rezoning news (~Sept 8), but has since given back the move: ~$5.10 down to ~$3.70 (-27%).

Stale signal / halal / unconfirmable

MTRN (Materion) — bullish MA crossover was Sept 17, 8 trading days old (outside the 5-day freshness window); catalyst also partly tied to a "customer investment to support US defense initiatives," muddying the exclusion screen either way.
C (Citigroup) — halal exclusion, conventional banking is the core business.
GME / RSG / GPI / QVCG — insider-buying cluster data dated Sept 14-20, outside the 5-day window, and not ticker-specific fresh price signals.
P / "Everpure" (formerly Pure Storage) — search flagged a fresh CFRA upgrade + AI-storage-demand story around Sept 24-25, but I couldn't resolve a reliable IBKR contract for the primary US listing to confirm live price/volume. Excluded rather than guess — worth a manual analyze P if you want to chase it yourself.

Also swept and found nothing concrete: general 52-week-high roundups, sector-rotation commentary, and gamma-squeeze/options-expiry searches returned think-pieces and stale monthly leaderboards rather than fresh, ticker-specific signals — not listed individually above since no candidate ticker emerged from them.

Research output, not financial advice. Past performance does not guarantee future results. Verify halal compliance quarterly on Zoya or Musaffa. Prices and price history from IBKR (get_price_snapshot / get_price_history), live-pulled at generation time; catalyst narratives from web search, cross-checked against IBKR and dropped or flagged where they disagreed. Account figures (net liq $533.80, cash $432.16) from IBKR get_account_summary/get_account_balances, live-pulled — more current than portfolio.json (last updated Aug 25). The stock-finder output alone is not enough to enter a trade; it's a first filter. Generated Sep 29, 2026, Kuwait time.
